person_relationships.description: Serves as Prime Minister under General Secretary To Lam; family connection through Lam's former boss (Hung's father Le Minh Huong was Minister of Public Security when Lam served under him)
Father; Colonel General, served as Minister of Public Security of Vietnam (1996-2002); was To Lam's former superior at the Ministry of Public Security
Pham Gia Tuc serves as Deputy Prime Minister in Hung's cabinet
Fellow member of the 14th Politburo; Tran Thanh Man serves as National Assembly Chairman while Hung serves as Prime Minister
Preceded Hung as Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam; served as Hung's superior during Hung's tenure as Deputy Governor

political_stances.stance_content: In his inaugural speech as Prime Minister, pledged to pursue high and sustainable economic growth; emphasized building a modern, enabling government that serves the people and demonstrating strong determination in managing the economy

As Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam, directed policies to control inflation, restructure poor-performing banks, reduce interest rates, direct credit toward production and business activities, and lower bad debts below 3%

Outlined five major government orientations: building a modern enabling government, ensuring effective operation of the organizational apparatus under the new administration, building a united and collaborative government, and building an honest and accountable government

Announced Politburo's establishment of a Central Steering Committee to oversee amendments and supplements to the Party Charter, ensuring alignment with practical conditions and the requirements of the new era

major_achievements.achievement: Became the second-youngest Governor in the history of the State Bank of Vietnam at age 46
Led monetary policy during a critical period, maintaining inflation control, restructuring non-performing loans below 3%, and guiding Vietnam's banking sector through COVID-19 economic challenges
Elevated to Politburo member and assigned as Head of the Central Organization Commission, one of the most powerful positions in the Party
Elected to the 14th Politburo at the 14th National Party Congress, positioning him as the presumptive Prime Minister designate
Unanimously elected as the 9th Prime Minister of Vietnam with 495/495 votes (100%) at the first session of the 16th National Assembly; youngest PM since 1955

biography_summary: 黎明兴（Le Minh Hung），1970年12月11日出生于越南河静省香山县，京族，现任越南政府总理。黎明兴出身政治世家，其父黎明香曾任越南公安部部长（1996-2002）。黎明兴毕业于越南国家大学外语学院法语专业，后赴日本埼玉大学攻读公共政策与经济学硕士学位，曾在中国上海财经大学短期学习。1993年起进入越南国家银行工作，在国际合作司历任科员、副处长、处长、副司长。2010年任人事司司长并进入国家银行党委，2011年任国家银行副行长。2014年调任越共中央办公厅副主任。2016年4月被任命为国家银行行长，成为该行历史上第二年轻的行长。任内有效控制通胀、重组不良贷款、引导信贷支持实体经济。2020年转任越共中央办公厅主任，2021年当选中央书记处书记。2024年5月补选为中央政治局委员，出任中央组织部部长。2026年1月在越共十四大上当选十四届中央政治局委员，同年4月7日经第十六届国会第一次会议全票当选为越南政府总理，成为1955年以来最年轻的总理。黎明兴兼任越日友好议员小组主席、中央反腐败反消极指导委员会副主任。
